items.title: Albert Warner and Sonny Henry Interview, 1959-01-08
items.q: Paul, he gets it done out. Yeah, he gets it on. One thing, buddy, one thing. If he isn't there, I'm really lost. Because I'm so used to him getting in the process.

ctx.x: You missed that part in the Eureka. Does the sax fill in on that part now or not?

Yes, the tenor sax. He's really good for that. Yeah, with that baritone, he sure gets it. No joke about that. Paul, he gets it done out. Yeah, he gets it on. One thing, buddy, one thing. If he isn't there, I'm really lost. Because I'm so used to him getting in the process.
Like that piece we played at West Long. And that solo. Yeah, that solo coming in just like that baritone.
